subject.title: feat(gateway): session dashboard domain — board RPCs, ticketed widgets, dashboard tool, per-agent persistence

question: Should the first supported dashboard contract include reconstructable `mcp-app` widgets, or should this landing be intentionally limited to HTML widgets until that public rendering boundary is designed?
rationale: The patch persists and advertises `mcp-app` widgets but supplies neither an authorized descriptor nor a renderable resource contract; choosing that long-lived protocol boundary is a maintainer product/API decision rather than a mechanical fix.

options.title: Define the MCP-app contract
options.body: Specify an authorized, renderable MCP-app descriptor or resource path and implement it with compatibility and gateway proof before merging.

options.title: Limit the first slice to HTML
options.body: Reject or defer `mcp-app` widget persistence in this PR so the initial public board contract contains only the fully renderable HTML path.

recommendation.title: Define the MCP-app contract
recommendation.body: Specify an authorized, renderable MCP-app descriptor or resource path and implement it with compatibility and gateway proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored both the current gateway implementation and the merged board UI foundation that consumes the widget contract.
